title: Quarterly Services Report (Second Quarter 2026) — the edition immediately before the AIES benchmark, and the live out-of-sample test of the advance->full revision bound, 10:00 a.m. ET
source: EST: two census.gov primaries fetched direct 2026-09-06 by the qss-q3-2026-12-10 initial-research adjacency sweep. (1) services/release_schedule.html, the QSS program's own schedule table, whose "2026 Quarter 2" row reads "Thursday, August 20, 2026" (advance) and "Wednesday, September 9, 2026" (full report). (2) economic-indicators/calendar-listview.html (HTTP 200, 91,396 bytes, 179 rows parsed), row "Quarterly Services Survey | September 9, 2026 | 10:00 AM | Second Quarter 2026", release code A202609091000, reference A202602. Corroborated by the live release itself: services/qss/qss-current.pdf (HTTP 200, 611,965 bytes) is CB26-139, the Q2 2026 advance, and its summary box reads "Next release: September 9, 2026". The Atlanta Fed's GDPNowcastDataReleaseDates.xlsx PostedUpdates sheet lists no GDPNow vintage on 2026-09-09. Filed estimate per the lane's no-self-confirm limit on an event discovered in-sweep, even though all three sources are primaries. Checked 2026-09-06
notes: DISCOVERED during the qss-q3-2026-12-10 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-06). This calendar tracks no Quarterly Services Survey edition other than the Q3 2026 pair, and this one is three days out. It earns a row for one measured reason, not for completeness. The 2026-12-10 full report's whole informational content is the size of its revision to the 2026-11-19 advance, and the record for that revision was just corrected: the Q1 2026 full report moved its advance by 0.20pp ("revised from the advance estimate of 0.9 percent" against a +1.1 percent headline, Wayback capture of qss-current.pdf, 2026-06-26), double the 0.10pp maximum in the 12-pair sample the advance-services-q3-2026-11-19 ledger registered its FT-1 against. This 09-09 release is the ONLY out-of-sample observation available before 12-10: it revises the 2026-08-20 advance's +3.1 percent (CB26-139, $6,421.9 billion) and so says whether the Q1 2026 breach was a one-off or a regime. It is also the last full report published on the PRE-benchmark basis — Census names the 2026-11-19 advance, not this release, as the 2023+2024 AIES benchmark carrier (services/index.html Announcements, read verbatim 2026-09-06). Impact LOW and symbols empty on the same measurements as its Q3 sibling: 0 of 1,871 GDPNow vintages name this survey, no vintage posts on 09-09, 0 macro- or services-keyed house playbooks. Note the corridor for whoever researches it: 09-09 is a Wednesday between ppi-2026-09-10 and cpi-2026-09-11, which is the ordinary shape for this series — 15 of 26 realized full-report dates share their session with CPI or PPI, against 1 of 26 for the advance half. Proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
